sources.notes: Primary current India clinical baseline for the first ANC/red-flag extraction package. The STW states that broad guidance is advisory and individual management remains with the treating physician.

sources.notes: Current NHM programme page confirms comprehensive ANC, early high-risk pregnancy detection, PMSMA/E-PMSMA follow-up, and MCP Card use. It is not used by itself to assign Janani symptom urgency.
